free_tier.stated: No free tier and no free trial. The homepage sells a USD 5.00/mo entry and a 14-day window is quoted by third-party review sites, not by the vendor page read.

per_object_cap.notes: an article size is a protocol convention, not a vendor number

retention.stated: 5000+ days retention on the primary, stated on the homepage price block

egress.terms: Up to 250 connections across 8 server locations on 6 continents

interface_detail: NNTP over TLS on port 563; no HTTP or object API exists for the download path, so a user drives it through SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav
tooling: SABnzbd, NZBGet or nzbdav over NNTP/TLS; any newsreader works because the protocol is the same everywhere, and no provider SDK is needed
chaining: One subscription gives a NetNews primary plus a UsenetFarm bonus server, the cheapest two-backbone stack; add a block only for content older than 5,000 days.

limits.value: the bundled UsenetFarm bonus server has a 1 TB/month cap - reported, not on the vendor page

limits_note: USD 5.99/mo monthly; USD 60/year including a Blocknews block account; the billing portal also lists a Yearly Unlimited at USD 35.00/year excluding Blocknews. 8 server locations: 2 US, 1 EU and single servers in Africa, Asia, Australia and South America, plus a bonus/backup EU server.
binding_note: Unlimited volume on the primary NetNews spool. The 1 TB/month cap applies only to the bundled UsenetFarm bonus server, which is a completion aid rather than the main feed.

identity_cost.detail: Email plus a paid order through billing.frugalusenet.com. No trial; a card is required before the first byte.

reliability_note: Two backbones in one plan: NetNews as primary and UsenetFarm as the bonus EU fill server, which is the cheapest way to get two independent feeds without buying two subscriptions.
confidence_note: Prices, connections and retention are from the vendor homepage read today. The USD 35/year figure is from the vendor's own billing portal, which contradicts the homepage's USD 60/year bundle; both are recorded.

evidence.proved: 'As Low As $5.00/Month'; '$5.99 Per Month w/ 5000+ Days Retention'; '$60 per year - incl/ Blocknews block account'; 'Up To 250 Connections'; 8 server locations
Yearly Unlimited Subscription $35.00 Per Year; 'Blocknews NOT Included'
Frugal Usenet on NetNews, AS6450; bonus UsenetFarm server capped at 1 TB/month

notes: The homepage and the billing portal quote different yearly prices for different bundles ($60 with a Blocknews block, $35 without), which is not a contradiction once the bundle is read, but it reads as one at a glance.
